products.title: Waterproof Wet Bags
products.body_html:
Meet the UpAiry Waterproof Wet Bag, the perfect sidekick for potty training on the go.

With two separate compartments, it keeps clean training pants and used ones neatly divided — no more digging through a messy bag. The fully waterproof, odor-locking fabric ensures everything stays contained, while the secure zippers prevent any unwanted leaks.

Whether you’re packing for daycare, errands, or just a walk in the park, this wet bag fits everything you need — and keeps the mess where it belongs. Lightweight, washable, and easy to hang anywhere, it’s the mess-proof solution every potty training parent needs.

products.body_html: Make potty training on-the-go stress-free with this adorable banana-shaped portable potty.
